description: A named set of users and groups, used either as an access list or as a department.

One type serves both: `US_type` says which. As an access list it decides who may use a queue, project or parallel environment; as a department it carries the share-tree and override tickets its members get. A userset may be both at once.

attributes.name: name
description: The set's name. `defaultdepartment` is the fallback department.

attributes.name: fshare
description: The department's share of functional tickets.

attributes.name: oticket
description: Override tickets granted to the department's jobs.

attributes.name: job_cnt
description: Jobs of this userset currently running, maintained by the scheduler for ticket calculation.

attributes.name: pending_job_cnt
description: Jobs of this userset waiting to run.

attributes.name: entries
description: The users and UNIX groups in the set (`UE`). A name starting with `@` is a group.

attributes.name: consider_with_categories
description: The set affects which jobs can run where, so two jobs differing only in it must not share a scheduling category.

attributes.name: joker
description: Placeholder which can be used for arbitrary data.
Its purpose is to be able to add new attributes without changing the spooling format.
It is a list of arbitrary type and it is spooled.
